`final class BlitGlMipmapBuilder`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IGlMipmapBuilder`](/reference/base-opengl/iglmipmapbuilder/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.texture` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [BlitGlMipmapBuilder.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/texture/BlitGlMipmapBuilder.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

Builds the mipmaps of a texture with one linear framebuffer blit per level, the path that matches the other backends pixel for pixel.
